nodes.label: Top Down Approach to Topological Duality Defects
nodes.author: Heckman, Hubner, Torres, Yu, Zhang

nodes.label: Topological Duality Defects
nodes.rationale: Non-invertible symmetry operators in 4D quantum field theories realized via 7-branes wrapped on Calabi-Yau singularities; implements field-theoretic duality as topological defect

nodes.label: 7-Branes and Branch Cuts
nodes.rationale: Extended objects in string theory whose monodromy matrices implement duality transformations; branch cuts localize anomalies and determine structure of topological defects

nodes.label: Symmetry Topological Field Theory (TFT)
nodes.rationale: 5D TFT governing anomalies of 4D SCFT; encodes 1-form symmetries and their mixed anomalies with 0-form duality/triality symmetries

nodes.label: D3-Brane Probes of Calabi-Yau Singularities
nodes.rationale: Top-down string theory construction of 4D SCFTs; D3-branes localized at singularity with 7-branes at infinity implementing duality defects

nodes.label: Dualities and Symmetries of Quantum Field Theories from Brane Engineering
nodes.author: Xingyang Yu
nodes.rationale: PhD dissertation studying dualities and generalized global symmetries in QFTs from string theory perspective using brane engineering

nodes.label: Spin(7) Orientifolds
nodes.rationale: New class of string theory backgrounds combining Joyce's construction of Spin(7) manifolds via anti-holomorphic involutions of CY4-folds with worldsheet parity, enabling engineering of 2d N=(0,1) gauge theories on D1-branes

nodes.label: 2d N=(0,1) Gauge Theories
nodes.rationale: Minimally supersymmetric 2d gauge theories with three types of supermultiplets: vector, scalar, and Fermi multiplets; lack holomorphy unlike N=(0,2) theories

nodes.label: 2d N=(0,2) Gauge Theories
nodes.rationale: Parent theories from which N=(0,1) theories are derived via orientifold projection; decomposed into N=(0,1) language for construction

nodes.label: Calabi-Yau 4-fold Singularities
nodes.rationale: 8-dimensional geometries with SU(4) holonomy; parent geometries for Spin(7) orientifolds via anti-holomorphic involutions

nodes.label: D1-branes Probing Singularities
nodes.rationale: Extended objects in string theory whose worldvolume theories encode QFT dynamics determined by singularity properties

nodes.label: 2d N=(0,1) Triality
nodes.rationale: IR duality between three 2d N=(0,1) gauge theories with SO/USp gauge groups; proposed in [35] with evidence from anomaly matching and elliptic genera

nodes.label: 2d N=(0,2) Triality
nodes.rationale: IR equivalence of three 2d N=(0,2) gauge theories; discovered in [19]; geometric realization via non-uniqueness of map between CY4 and gauge theories

nodes.label: Non-invertible Duality Symmetries
nodes.rationale: Generalized symmetry operators with non-trivial fusion rules; arise from topological defects in QFTs; implemented via 7-branes at infinity in string theory

nodes.label: Topological Duality Defects
nodes.rationale: Codimension-one topological interfaces implementing duality transformations; arise from 7-branes wrapped on boundary of CY cone; do not contribute to stress-energy tensor

nodes.label: D3-branes Probing Calabi-Yau Threefolds
nodes.rationale: Worldvolume theories of D3-branes at CY3 singularities; 4d N=1 SCFTs with marginal couplings descending from IIB axio-dilaton

nodes.label: Seiberg Duality
nodes.rationale: IR equivalence between electric and magnetic 4d N=1 gauge theories; geometric realization via non-uniqueness of theories on D3-branes at CY3 singularities

nodes.label: Brane Engineering
nodes.rationale: Systematic approach to constructing QFTs via D-branes probing singular geometries; provides geometric perspectives on dualities and symmetries

nodes.label: Generalized Global Symmetries
nodes.rationale: Higher-form symmetries and topological operators; realized via branes at infinity in string theory; provide constraints on QFT dynamics

nodes.label: Symmetry TFT
nodes.rationale: 5d topological field theory obtained from dimensional reduction of IIB Chern-Simons term on boundary of CY cone; encodes global structure and defect group of 4d theory

nodes.label: Anti-holomorphic Involutions
nodes.rationale: Z2 symmetries of parent N=(0,2) theories that map chiral fields to conjugates; preserve Cayley 4-form; define orientifold quotient action

nodes.label: Universal Involution
nodes.rationale: Anti-holomorphic involution applicable to any CY4; maps all gauge groups to themselves and all chiral fields to themselves anti-holomorphically; realizes N=(0,1) theories as real slices of N=(0,2)

nodes.label: Vector Structure in Orientifolds
nodes.rationale: Discrete choice in orientifold quotient determining whether gauge bundle admits vector representation; different choices lead to inequivalent theories for same geometric involution

nodes.label: Mesonic Moduli Space
nodes.rationale: Moduli space of gauge-invariant chiral operators; coincides with CY4 geometry; generators parameterize coordinates; anti-holomorphic involution acts on generators

nodes.label: Hilbert Series Technique
nodes.rationale: Computational tool for extracting generators and relations of mesonic moduli space; uses Plethystic Exponential and Logarithm

nodes.label: Brane Brick Models
nodes.rationale: Combinatorial models encoding 2d N=(0,2) gauge theories on D1-branes probing toric CY4-folds; connected to theories via T-duality

nodes.label: Joyce's Construction of Spin(7) Manifolds
nodes.rationale: Geometric construction of Spin(7) manifolds as quotients of CY4-folds by anti-holomorphic involutions; Cayley 4-form is invariant under involution

nodes.label: Gauge Anomaly Cancellation
nodes.rationale: Consistency requirement for 2d gauge theories; computed via 1-loop diagrams; may require introduction of flavor branes in orientifold theories

nodes.label: Partial Resolution and Higgsing
nodes.rationale: Geometric partial resolutions of CY4 singularities map to higgsing of gauge theories; symmetric resolutions project to higgsing of orientifold theories

nodes.label: C^4 and Orbifold Singularities
nodes.rationale: Simplest CY4 and its Z2 orbifolds; parent geometries for explicit Spin(7) orientifold constructions; exhibit enhanced SUSY in special cases

nodes.label: D_3 Geometry
nodes.rationale: Non-orbifold toric CY4 singularity; admits Spin(7) orientifolds with SO×U gauge groups; illustrates orientifold construction beyond orbifolds

nodes.label: H_4 Geometry
nodes.rationale: Non-orbifold toric CY4 with multiple phases related by N=(0,2) triality; admits Spin(7) orientifolds with and without vector structure

nodes.label: Q^{1,1,1} Geometry
nodes.rationale: Toric CY4 with multiple phases; admits non-universal Spin(7) orientifolds leading to generalized N=(0,1) triality with mixed SO/USp gauge groups

nodes.label: Q^{1,1,1}/Z_2 Geometry
nodes.rationale: Z2 orbifold of Q^{1,1,1}; admits 14 toric phases; Spin(7) orientifolds produce theories with U(N) and SO(N) gauge groups; exhibits U(N) triality

nodes.label: SL(2,Z) Duality of Type IIB
nodes.rationale: Fundamental duality of type IIB string theory; descends to duality transformations in 4d QFTs on D3-branes; acts on axio-dilaton and RR/NS-NS 2-form potentials

nodes.label: 7-branes at Infinity
nodes.rationale: Bound states of (p,q) 7-branes wrapped on boundary of CY cone; implement SL(2,Z) transformations; give rise to topological duality defects in 4d theory

nodes.label: Branch Cuts in 5D TFT
nodes.rationale: Codimension-two defects in 5D symmetry TFT descending from 7-branes; choice of branch cut termination determines defect structure and anomaly inflow

nodes.label: N=4 Super Yang-Mills Theory
nodes.rationale: Maximally supersymmetric 4d gauge theory; realized as worldvolume of D3-branes in flat space; admits duality and triality defects

nodes.label: N=1 Superconformal Field Theories
nodes.rationale: 4d theories with minimal supersymmetry; realized via D3-branes probing CY3 singularities; admit duality defects at tuned points on conformal manifold

nodes.label: Chapter 2: Spin(7) Orientifolds and 2d N=(0,1) Gauge Theories
nodes.rationale: Based on [1]; introduces Spin(7) orientifolds and constructs 2d N=(0,1) gauge theories on D1-branes; discusses universal involution, vector structure, and partial resolutions

nodes.label: Chapter 3: Spin(7) Orientifolds and 2d N=(0,1) Trialities
nodes.rationale: Based on [2]; provides geometric perspective on N=(0,1) triality via non-uniqueness of Spin(7) orientifold map; extends triality to coupled N=(0,2) and N=(0,1) sectors

nodes.label: Chapter 4: Top-Down Approach to Topological Duality Defects
nodes.rationale: Based on [3]; constructs non-invertible duality defects in 4d QFTs via 7-branes at infinity; shows different field-theoretic realizations correspond to distinct branch cut choices
